name: pdgo
description: Project Development Governance Orchestrator (PDGO): governed project routing, planning, execution, review, memory, and audit.

interface.longDescription: Project Development Governance Orchestrator (PDGO) provides human-approved scenario routing, staged planning, isolated execution, evidence-based review, memory, and audited Agent dispatch.
